newsitem.title: USA: Puget Sound Energy files choice pilot.
newsitem.headline: Puget Sound Energy files choice pilot.

text.p: Puget Sound Energy said Tuesday it filed with the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission (WUTC) a proposal to launch a two-year pilot program aimed at testing the opening of the electricity market to competition.
The pilot program would be made available to a cross section of around 85,000 Puget Sound Energy electric customers.

"This proposed pilot for 10 percent of our electric customers is designed to help participants learn about the operational issues and outcomes of opening up the electric market to all groups of customers," said James Heidell, Puget Sound Energy director of state and federal regulation.
If approved by the WUTC, the pilot project would begin in November.
The WUTC is expected to make a decision about the pilot by September 1.
